host.conditions: GitHub-hosted virtual machine. Reported topology does not establish physical placement or dedicated CPU access. No per-sample host load, frequency, affinity or power telemetry.

method.order: Four cyclic configuration orders, each occupying every position once; worker order reversed on odd repetitions. Processes below retain exact execution order.
method.validation: All 144 process exits are zero. All 1008 sample checksums match independent recurrence or closed-form oracles. All C# processes report .NET 10.0.10, X64, and workstation GC.
method.sampleEncoding: Each milliseconds array retains samples 0..6 in order. All seven checksums in each process equal its checksum field.
method.statistic: Median of four process medians; process metrics include setup, warmup and reporting, while kernel milliseconds do not.
method.nativeExecution: A verified macOS frontend exports canonical IR; the native Linux backend emits x86-64 ELF machine code. The workflow verifies source and transport hashes before lowering. No emulation is used.

limitations: Allocation-batch improves only from 144.5 to 137 ms between two and four workers; the data do not isolate allocator, collection, cache or VM scheduling costs.
Neri is slower than all three .NET references at every matched worker count for allocation-batch in this run.
The .NET references use workstation GC. This record contains no server-GC comparison.
Task-local allocation, traversal, collection and joining are timed together. Only scalar results cross the join; managed graph adoption and mutable-input transfer are not measured.
This AMD VM differs from the Intel Xeon VM in scoped-tasks-linux-x86_64.json. Their absolute times cannot isolate a compiler/runtime change.
VM results do not establish dedicated-PC behavior or optimal physical-core utilization.

references.title: Hierarchical Memory Management for Parallel Programs (2016)
references.relevance: Independent task heaps motivate concurrent collection. Neri's nonmoving collector and ownership adoption are distinct from the paper's copying mechanism and formal calculus.

references.title: Microsoft: workstation and server garbage collection
references.relevance: GC mode changes the execution and memory configuration of parallel allocation workloads.
